name: Peanut oil fatty acid
description: Peanut oil fatty acid (CAS 91051-35-3 ) is a mixed fatty acid blend derived from refined peanut oil, composed primarily of oleic and linoleic acids with minor saturated fractions. It functions as a functional lipid ingredient across food processing, personal care, and industrial formulation. This material is valued for its balanced fatty acid profile and compatibility with a broad range of base systems. In personal care, it acts as an emollient and moisturizing agent in skin creams, lotions, and hair conditioners. Its unsaturated acid content supports skin barrier function without heavy residue. Food-grade material is used in emulsifier synthesis and as a precursor for mono- and diglyceride production in processed food manufacturing. Industrial formulators incorporate it into lubricant blends and metalworking fluids. Its oleic-rich composition provides boundary lubrication under moderate load conditions, making it ideal for various mechanical applications. In coatings and adhesive systems, it serves as a reactive intermediate or plasticizing component to improve film flexibility and adhesion. This versatility makes it a staple in chemical manufacturing and industrial design. Peanut oil fatty acid is supplied as an amber to yellow liquid at ambient temperature. Food-grade and technical-grade specifications are the standard commercial offerings for global distribution and logistics. Food-grade material typically meets FCC or equivalent purity requirements for safety and compliance.
